description: This file defines types, interfaces, and functions related to inter-process communication (IPC) in the Playwright testing framework, including configuration serialization, payload structures for test events, and utility functions.

methods.name: serializeConfig
methods.description: Serializes the full configuration object into a structured format, optionally including the compilation cache and metadata.

methods.name: stdioChunkToParams
methods.description: Converts a chunk of data (Uint8Array or string) into a TestOutputPayload, encoding buffers as base64 strings.
